reasons: Deviation is correctly classified: the cap is measured by "Fees", which § 1.5/1.6 define as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form only, so the cap is an illusory fixed amount far below the fallback of 12 months' fees and within walk-away territory (Vendor cap below 6 months' fees). This is exactly the illusory-definition scenario the detection guidance flags.

Redline is actionable and directionally correct: it replaces only the cap-basis sentence with the preferred greater-of formulation (all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months, or USD 1,000,000), deliberately bypassing the narrow "Fees" definition and the "first Order Form" limitation.

Minimal-edit discipline respected: the mutual-cap sentence, the mutual exclusion of indirect damages and the § 21.3 Excluded Claims set (including the payment-obligation carve-out) are left untouched, so no over-editing of already-compliant elements; the 0.436 changed-character ratio reflects a necessary single-sentence basis replacement.

Comment is accurate, correctly attributes the problem to the definition of "Fees", states the playbook position, and confirms indemnification and confidentiality/data-protection breaches remain outside the cap; tone and prefix conform.
